settings.text:
UV Shield+ is a dermatologist-formulated daily supplement designed for people who spend significant time outdoors.

Its five-ingredient formula is built around complementary nutritional and antioxidant pathways associated with environmental and UV-related skin stress. It combines niacinamide, Polypodium leucotomos, trans-resveratrol, EGCG, and spirulina rather than relying on a single ingredient or mechanism.

settings.items:
Supports skin exposed to daily environmental stress
Provides multi-pathway antioxidant support
Supports skin resilience from within
Designed for active, sun-exposed lifestyles
Complements sunscreen and smart sun habits

settings.text: UV Shield+ is designed to work alongside sunscreen, not replace it.

settings.heading: Daily internal support for life outdoors.
settings.body:
UV Shield+ is built for the reality that outdoor life exposes skin to more than one type of stress.

The formula uses five ingredients with different nutritional and biochemical roles so the support is broader than a single antioxidant or botanical alone.

settings.heading: Sun exposure is a daily reality.
settings.body:
Your skin is a living organ constantly responding to the environment.

Outdoor exposure can influence oxidative stress, inflammatory signaling, cellular energy demands, and the skin's barrier systems.

That does not mean avoiding the outdoors. It means supporting skin through a layered routine:
settings.callout: UV Shield+ belongs in the third layer. It does not replace the first.

settings.title: External protection
settings.text: Broad-spectrum sunscreen, protective clothing, shade, and reapplication.

settings.title: Internal support
settings.text: Targeted nutrients and botanicals selected for complementary roles in skin-health biology.

settings.name: Niacinamide
settings.text:
Niacinamide is a form of vitamin B3 involved in cellular energy metabolism and multiple skin-related biological processes.

Within UV Shield+, it provides a different mechanism from the formula's plant polyphenols, giving the formulation broader pathway coverage.

settings.name: Polypodium leucotomos
settings.text:
Polypodium leucotomos is a fern-derived botanical studied in relation to skin responses to ultraviolet exposure.

In the formula architecture, it contributes a different botanical and antioxidant profile from niacinamide and the polyphenols.

settings.name: EGCG
settings.text:
EGCG is a green-tea catechin studied for antioxidant and cell-signaling activity.

It is potentially complementary with Polypodium leucotomos and resveratrol across oxidative and inflammatory-response pathways.

settings.name: Trans-resveratrol
settings.text:
Resveratrol is a plant polyphenol with antioxidant and cell-signaling activity.

Within the formula, it contributes overlapping but distinct redox and signaling support alongside EGCG and Polypodium leucotomos.

settings.name: Spirulina
settings.text:
Spirulina adds nutrient-derived antioxidant activity to the broader polyphenol and botanical network.

It is viewed as complementary rather than a stand-alone mechanism.

settings.heading: Why combine these ingredients?
settings.caption: This section describes formulation rationale. UV Shield+ as a finished product has not been established here as clinically tested for these combined outcomes.

settings.title: Polypodium + EGCG
settings.text: Potentially broader coverage of UV-associated cellular stress.

settings.title: Resveratrol + EGCG
settings.text: Two polyphenols with overlapping antioxidant and signaling roles.

settings.title: Niacinamide + Polyphenols
settings.text: Different biological mechanisms working in the same formula.

settings.heading: What is oxidative stress?
settings.body:
Oxidative stress describes an imbalance between reactive molecules and the body's antioxidant defenses.

Environmental exposure can contribute to reactive oxygen species in skin.

Antioxidants do not act like sunscreen. They work through internal biochemical pathways rather than blocking UV radiation at the skin surface.

That distinction matters.
settings.takeaway: UV Shield+ is formulated to support those internal systems, not to replace external protection.

settings.heading: Resilient skin starts with a functional barrier.
settings.body:
The skin barrier helps regulate water loss and acts as a physical interface with the outside world.

Skin-barrier biology involves lipids, proteins, hydration, and normal cellular turnover.

Niacinamide has been studied in relation to several aspects of barrier biology, which is one reason it serves as a foundational nutrient in the UV Shield+ formula.

settings.note: Consult your healthcare professional before taking if you are pregnant, nursing, taking any medications or have a medical condition.

settings.heading: Created through a dermatologist's lens.
settings.body:
Alchemia MD was created to bring dermatological thinking into daily supplementation.

Rather than asking customers to piece together an assortment of individual supplements, each formula is designed around a defined skin-health role and a transparent ingredient rationale.

settings.question: What is UV Shield+?
settings.answer: UV Shield+ is a dermatologist-formulated dietary supplement designed to support skin exposed to active outdoor life through targeted nutritional, botanical, and antioxidant ingredients.

settings.question: Does UV Shield+ replace sunscreen?
settings.answer: No. UV Shield+ is designed to complement sunscreen and smart sun habits, not replace them.

settings.question: Does UV Shield+ prevent sunburn?
settings.answer: No. UV Shield+ is not sunscreen and is not intended to prevent sunburn.

settings.question: When should I take UV Shield+?
settings.answer: Take two (2) capsules once daily with water. For enhanced support, take two (2) capsules twice daily with water.

settings.question: Can I take UV Shield+ year-round?
settings.answer: UV Shield+ is positioned as daily support. Take it as directed on the label; no seasonal restriction is stated.

settings.question: Can I use UV Shield+ with my skincare routine?
settings.answer: Yes. It is positioned as internal support intended to complement topical skincare and sun-safety practices.

settings.question: Is UV Shield+ part of a system?
settings.answer: Yes. UV Shield+ is included in the Sun Safe System and Sun Resilience System, while also being available as an individual formula.

settings.extra_line: UV Shield+ is not a replacement for sunscreen. Use with topical sunscreen, protective clothing, shade, and smart sun habits.

settings.heading: Support the skin that keeps up with your life.
settings.body: Five targeted ingredients. One dermatologist-formulated daily routine for people who spend their lives outdoors.
